01: They accused his mother. She said nothing... She only pointed at her newborn baby.
03: This one did. And his very first words changed everything.
04: Maryam, peace be upon her, came back to her people, carrying her baby. They said: O Maryam, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
06: She pointed to him. They asked: How can we speak to a child in the cradle? ... And then, the child spoke.
07: Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture, and made me a prophet.
08: His very first words... I am the servant of Allah.
09: He didn't say, worship me. He said: I am the servant of Allah.
10: By the permission of Allah, he shaped birds from clay, and they flew. He healed the blind, and he gave life to the dead, by the permission of Allah.
11: They planned to kill him. But they did not kill him, and they did not crucify him. Rather, Allah raised him up to Himself.
13: With Allah. And the Prophet, peace be upon him, told us: before the Last Hour, Isa, son of Maryam, peace be upon him, will come down again.
